old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because the source omits all six request bytes and an intended final watchdog policy. IPMI section 27.6 authoritatively defines every standard field, reserved value, 100 ms countdown unit, stop/don't-stop behavior and completion-only response; section 27.7 defines complete readback. The missing intended policy is a Project configuration choice that can be safely parameterized rather than an unknown command semantic.
disposition_reason: Never send the bare command. Compile one Project-approved six-byte policy vector from the standard field map, complete baseline and safe timing rules, obtain immediate approval, issue it once on an isolated/recoverable target, verify every field with Get Watchdog 0x25, and restore the exact captured baseline before any unsafe action can occur. Preserve all timer-use, pre-timeout, timeout-action, expiration-flag and countdown coverage as an explicit Project matrix; do not guess a policy or treat command completion as PASS.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1001, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1002 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1002 / variant 4ca400154259ae7d.

IPMI v2.0 section 27.6 defines a six-byte Set Watchdog payload: timer use/log/don't-stop; pre-timeout interrupt and timeout action; pre-timeout seconds; expiration flags to clear; and little-endian initial countdown in 100 ms units.

The standard defines no-action, Hard Reset, Power Down and Power Cycle plus SMI/NMI/Messaging pre-timeout values and reserved encodings. Those semantics are not OEM-unknown; an approved Project policy can select required vectors while rejecting reserved or unsupported options.

Set normally stops a running timer, may clear the pre-timeout flag, and can continue/reload it with the don't-stop bit. A zero countdown can cause immediate action after Reset, and near-boundary updates have race conditions. Baseline, safe margin, readback and restoration are mandatory.

ED-03, ED-06, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-28 and ED-30 permit a standards-based parameterized case but require exact Expected, approval, evidence and recovery; ED-33 through ED-38 prohibit bare execution, Get-only substitution and retries.

test_case.test_name: Set one approved standard IPMI watchdog policy, read it back and restore baseline
test_case.purpose: Verify the bound BMC accepts an exact Project-selected standard watchdog policy and reports every field correctly, while protecting workloads and restoring the original watchdog state without allowing an unintended pre-timeout interrupt, reset, power down or power cycle.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/local-IPMI mapping, pinned firmware/ipmitool/parser/Script and exact standard field encoder/decoder with reserved-bit validation

Versioned Project coverage matrix selecting required timer-use, logging, don't-stop, pre-timeout interrupt, timeout-action, pre-timeout, expiration-clear and initial-countdown vectors; unsupported/N/A entries require platform SPEC evidence

Complete raw 0x06/0x25 baseline including running state, all configuration, expiration flags and present countdown, plus an exact owner-approved baseline restoration vector and running/stopped restoration sequence

Safety proof for each vector: nonzero sufficiently long countdown, pre-timeout/expiry margin, supported interrupt/action, whether flags may be cleared, bounded readback/restore deadline and no unintended action window
Isolated or explicitly authorized target, drained/protected workload, host power/boot and BMC observer, independent OOB/console recovery, immediate approval and preserved logs
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Verify target and read raw 0x06/0x25 to capture the complete watchdog/host baseline. Select exactly one approved matrix vector and compile all six data bytes after `0x06 0x24`; decode them back before use and reject reserved bits/values, zero or unsafe countdown, unsupported interrupt/action, unauthorized expiration-flag clearing, near-boundary race, insufficient restore margin or missing recovery. After immediate approval send the exact request once, require completion 00 and no unexpected payload, then read 0x25 and compare every represented field to the selected vector. Do not call Reset 0x22 unless the approved vector specifically requires starting and separately authorizes it. Before the earliest pre-timeout/expiry, restore the exact baseline with an independently approved Set request and, only if baseline was running, its approved start sequence; read back and prove baseline plus host/workload/BMC health. Stop on any anomaly; never send bare 0x24, sweep policies, clear unapproved flags, let a destructive action fire or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The single approved six-byte Set completes successfully; Get 0x25 exactly reflects the requested timer-use/logging, running semantics, interrupt/action, pre-timeout, permitted expiration-flag handling and initial countdown. No unintended interrupt or host power/reset occurs. The approved restoration completes before the safety deadline and full watchdog plus host baseline is re-established.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an approved complete vector, exact target, safe timing/recovery proof, one Set, completion 00, field-for-field 0x25 readback, expected running/stopped behavior, no unintended action and exact baseline restoration. Bare 0x24, command success alone, guessed/default bytes, reserved/unsupported values, zero/unsafe countdown, unauthorized flag clearing, Get-only evidence, missed restoration deadline, host impact or automatic retry cannot pass. Missing Project policy is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Require immediate confirmation after presenting exact decoded six-byte vector, baseline, earliest pre-timeout/expiry, intended running behavior, workload/OOB state and restoration sequence.
Deny bare 0x06/0x24, reserved values/bits, zero or unsafe initial count, unsupported pre-timeout/timeout actions and any vector without sufficient readback/restore margin.
Do not clear any expiration flag unless that exact source-preserved field is a separately approved matrix objective and its evidence is captured first.
Do not let Hard Reset, Power Down or Power Cycle occur merely to prove Set coverage; action-effect testing is separate destructive coverage. Monitor host power/boot continuously.
Preserve logs and use protected local/verified access; prohibit sshpass, plaintext credentials, host-key bypass and generic log clearing.
No automatic retry. Stop on completion/readback drift, countdown anomaly, interrupt, host transition, management loss or failed restore and invoke only the separately approved recovery.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact DUT/BMC/local-IPMI identity, pinned firmware/tool/parser/Script and Project coverage-vector revision
Complete pre-state raw 0x25 decode, host/workload baseline, safety timing calculation and independent recovery readiness
Exact six request bytes with decoded field trace, IPMI completion/response framing and post-Set full 0x25 comparison
Countdown/running-state and no-unintended-action timeline with preserved expiration/log evidence
Exact restoration requests/readback, full watchdog/host baseline comparison, no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If Set/readback or timing is unexpected, stop all retries and use the independent observer to protect the host. Before any approved safe deadline, only the owner may authorize the pre-reviewed standards-compliant baseline Set/start sequence; if that is unsafe or fails, do not improvise Reset/power actions—use the isolated OOB/console incident runbook, preserve all evidence and escalate.

source_conflict.reason: The source omits required data bytes, but the authoritative IPMI schema supplies their semantics without contradicting the Set identity. The intended policy is now an explicit Project parameter and PASS requires readback/restoration, so the prior undefined-command conflict is reconciled without guessing.

blocked.reason: Core command semantics, response and recovery primitives are standardized. The exact safe policy vector, applicability, timing and restoration are finite Project inputs subject to confirmation.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: DUT/BMC mapping; pinned encoder/parser/Script; approved full watchdog coverage vectors and supported actions; baseline restore/start sequence; timing margin; isolated workload/OOB recovery and point-of-action approval.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO WATCHDOG, IPMI, INTERRUPT, LOG, RESET, POWER, HOST OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 27.3 through 27.7 and Tables 27-3/27-4 define the six-byte Set schema, actions, units, stop/don't-stop and flag behavior, race conditions and complete Get readback used for acceptance/restoration.

project_authority: The Project owner selects and approves exact standard policy vectors, supported optional interrupts/actions, safe timing and baseline restoration. This is parameterization of defined fields, not permission to guess bytes, run reserved values or fire destructive timeout actions.
